info.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 25 at 9:07PM MDT until September 25 at 9:30PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
info.description:
TORABQ
The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a
* Tornado Warning for... East Central Curry County in east central New Mexico...
* Until 930 PM MDT.
* At 907 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located 5 miles northeast of Clovis, moving northeast at 25 mph.
HAZARD...Tornado.
SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.
IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is likely.
* Locations impacted include... Clovis and Pleasant Hill.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris.
Tornadoes are difficult to observe at night. Take cover now!

parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 9:30 PM MDT. Take shelter now. Check media.

National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 9:30 PM MDT. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.
